notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (tier 1); robots.txt has only a single 'User-agent: *' block disallowing /de/account, /de/wishlist, /de/basket, /de/checkout, /de/order, /prudsys, /api - no Claude-specific opt-out, all /de/c/ category paths are crawlable. Discovery method: (1) fetched the site's embedded Angular Universal state (script#serverApp-state on any PLP) which contains the full 'megaMenus' desktop-nav JSON (contentTypeId=megaMenus) - this gave the authoritative internal names/categoryIds for the Herbst (Autumn), Weihnachten (Christmas) and Adventsdeko (Advent) branches; (2) direct HTTP fetch + HTML parse of every discovered/guessed PLP URL for the exact 'N Artikel' filter-bar total; (3) internal href scan of the Ostern (Easter) and Weihnachten hub pages for further sub-category links; (4) direct slug probing for Valentinstag/Muttertag/Vatertag/standalone Halloween - all 404; (5) internal site search (/de/search?q=...) confirmed NOT discriminating (returns the same ~986-item default result set regardless of query, matching the known false-absence trap) so it was used only to surface the 'Weihnachten' facet link, never as proof of absence. sitemap.xml returned a bucket 404 (NoSuchKey), unusable. No Diwali/Eid/Holi/other South-Asian festival, Valentine's Day, Mother's/Father's Day, or Thanksgiving category exists on this German site. Grouping policy: several parent nodes (Weihnachten 253 Artikel, Herbst 179, Fruehling no own count, Fruehlingsblumen 41, Textilien-Fruehling 54, Tischdeko-Fruehling 116, Osterdeko 10, Ostern main, Tischdeko-Ostern 18, Adventsdeko main) have their own PLP but their listed children do not sum exactly to the parent total (parent includes extra uncategorized items) - per the shared core's grouping rule these parents were written as name-only grouping rows (qty:null, link:null) rather than double-reporting an approximate/overlapping total; their real per-child counts are the leaf rows. One zero-qty child (Fruehlings Tuerkraenze / Spring Door Wreaths, /de/c/fruehling/fruehlingsblumen/kraenze-fuer-den-fruehling, 0 Artikel) was dropped per the 0-product-category rule. Halloween: the site's own internal category name for this PLP is 'Herbstliche Anlaesse' (Autumn Occasions), nested under Herbst, but every product in it (skull shot glass, knit pumpkin, 'Boo' foil balloons, black/orange tablecloths and candle holders) is unambiguously Halloween merchandise, so it is classified as Halloween per Rule 0 (product type over site label) rather than folded into the generic Autumn bucket. Advent (Adventskerzen/Adventskraenze/Adventskalender, hosted at /de/c/adventsdeko/...) is classified under Christmas since Advent is the Christmas run-up season in German retail and the ruleset's own worked example lists 'Christmas Wreaths' as a valid Christmas sub-category. Autumn and Spring are generic seasonal-merchandising lines (not tied to one named occasion) but are explicitly sanctioned as valid 'other genuine seasonal events' by seasonal.md Sec3 - flagged MANUAL REVIEW on the top grouping row of each so a reviewer can decide whether to keep or drop the whole branch if the project wants named-holiday-only coverage.
